decisive_items: Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
Positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
Negative for cluster of differentiation 34 and pan-cytokeratin
response.rationale: Tubal/cornual location with a smooth-muscle immunophenotype and benign morphology best fits leiomyoma of the uterine tube; adenomatoid tumor is excluded by negative pan-cytokeratin, while uterine leiomyoma is anatomically less specific.

rejected.why: Benign frozen section, well-demarcated border, and no mitotic atypia do not support uncertain malignant potential.
Fibromyxoid stroma and perivascular epithelioid cords are not typical of the cellular subtype, and the mass is tubal rather than uterine.
Same smooth-muscle immunophenotype but the mass arises from the right tube/cornual area rather than the uterus proper.
Benign lesion, well-demarcated border, and absence of mitotic atypia contradict leiomyosarcoma.
Pathology shows a circumscribed smooth-muscle neoplasm, not adenomyosis.
Negative pan-cytokeratin and positive desmin/SMA/ER/PR favor smooth-muscle origin over an adenomatoid tumor.
